newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan private demand getting firmer - BOJ report.
newsitem.headline: Japan private demand getting firmer - BOJ report.

text.p: Japan's private demand shows increasing firmness, the Bank of Japan (BOJ) said on Tuesday in a monthly economic report.
"A moderate economic recovery continues in Japan as private demand shows increasing firmness," the report said.
Net exports are on a rising trend while public-sector investment has decreased, it said. Personal consumption is recovering moderately, with passenger car sales increasing significantly.
Labour conditions on the whole have continued to improve moderately, the report said.
Industrial production has shown a steady increase, while housing investment and capital spending are increasing steadily.
Prices of goods have stopped declining and money supply has continued to grow at a level of between three and four percent, the report said.
